summary: Nauticus Robotics filed an 8-K on September 18, 2026, reporting a Fifth Amendment to its September 18, 2023 Senior Secured Term Loan Agreement entered into with each lender between September 15 and 17, 2026, dated as of September 14, 2026, alongside a Collateral Agent Acknowledgment and Consent. The amendment again reduces the conversion price on the convertible term loans, continuing a series of temporary repricing amendments (from $6.00 to $1.76, $2.20, $1.80, and now the Fifth Amendment). No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or strategic transaction is involved; this is a routine financing amendment, with dilution and Nasdaq compliance as the risk-arb watch items.
